chunks: Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has around the Ka'bah one hundred and twenty mercies: sixty of them for those performing tawaf, forty for those praying, and twenty for those looking.

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka'bah, the sacred House in Makkah
key_terms.لِلطَّائِفِينَ: for those performing tawaf around the Ka'bah
key_terms.لِلنَّاظِرِينَ: for those looking at the Ka'bah

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the mercy of Allah around the Ka'bah?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the special divine mercy present around the Ka'bah and how it is distributed among acts of worship connected to it. It highlights the spiritual rank of tawaf, salat (prayer), and even gazing upon the Ka'bah within the sacred setting of hajj.
